title.zh: 卷八十五 列傳第四十五 謝莊 王景文
title.en: Volume 85 Biographies 45: Xie Zhuang, Wang Jingwen
title.raw: 卷八十五 列傳第四十五 謝莊 王景文 Volume 85 Biographies 45: Xie Zhuang, Wang Jingwen

sentences.zh: 列傳第四十五 謝莊 王景文

translations.literal: Biographies 45: Xie Zhuang, Wang Jingwen
translations.idiomatic: Biography 45: Xie Zhuang and Wang Jingwen

sentences.zh: 謝莊，字希逸，陳郡陽夏人，太常弘微子也。

translations.literal: Xie Zhuang, styled Xiyi, was a man of Yangxia in Chen Commandery, son of Grand Master of Ceremonies Hongwei.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Zhuang, courtesy name Xiyi, was from Yangxia in Chen Commandery and was the son of Grand Master of Ceremonies Xie Hongwei.

sentences.zh: 年七歲，能屬文，通《論語》。

translations.literal: At age seven he could compose literary pieces and had mastered the Analects.
translations.idiomatic: At seven he could already compose essays and had mastered the Analects.

sentences.zh: 及長，韶令美容儀，太祖見而異之，謂尚書僕射殷景仁、領軍將軍劉湛曰：「藍田出玉，豈虛也哉！」

translations.literal: When he grew up he was refined and handsome in bearing. The Founder Emperor saw him and was struck by him, and said to Vice Director of the Secretariat Yin Jingren and General-in-Chief of the Guards Liu Zhan: "Jade comes forth from Lantian—is that not true!"
translations.idiomatic: When he reached adulthood he was graceful in manner and striking in appearance. Emperor Wen saw him and was greatly impressed, and said to Vice Director of the Secretariat Yin Jingren and General-in-Chief of the Guards Liu Zhan, "They say jade comes from Lantian—how true that is!"

sentences.zh: 初為始興王濬後軍法曹行參軍，轉太子舍人，廬陵王文學，太子洗馬，中舍人，廬陵王紹南中郎諮議參軍。

translations.literal: He first served as acting Registrar of the Rear Army for Prince of Shixing Jun, then became Crown Prince Attendant, Literary Companion to the Prince of Luling, Crown Prince Groom, Palace Attendant, and Adviser to the Southern Gentlemen of the Prince of Luling Shao.
translations.idiomatic: He began as acting registrar of the rear army under Prince Shixing Jun, then served successively as crown prince attendant, literary companion to the Prince of Luling, crown prince groom, palace attendant, and adviser on the staff of Prince Luling Shao's southern commandery.

sentences.zh: 又轉隨王誕後軍諮議，并領記室。

translations.literal: He was then transferred to Rear Army Adviser under Prince of Sui Dan, and also held the post of Recorder.
translations.idiomatic: He was later transferred to rear-army adviser under Prince Sui Dan and also served as his recorder.

sentences.zh: 分左氏《經傳》，隨國立篇，制木方丈，圖山川土地，各有分理，離之則州別郡殊，合之則宇內為一。

translations.literal: He divided the Zuo Commentary into sections by state, made a wooden map one square zhang in size, and charted mountains, rivers, and lands, each with its proper division; separated, provinces and commanderies differed, joined together, the realm within the Four Seas was one.
translations.idiomatic: He divided the Zuo Commentary into sections organized by state, fashioned a wooden map one zhang square, and charted mountains, rivers, and territory so that each had its proper division—taken apart, provinces and commanderies stood distinct; assembled, the empire within the seas formed a single whole.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十七年，索虜寇彭城，虜遣尚書李孝伯來使，與鎮軍長史張暢共語，孝伯訪問莊及王徽，其名聲遠布如此。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia the northern barbarians raided Pengcheng; the enemy sent Minister Li Xiaobo as envoy. He conversed with Chief Clerk of the Pacification Army Zhang Chang, and Xiaobo inquired after Zhuang and Wang Hui—his fame had spread so far.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia the northern enemies attacked Pengcheng and sent Minister Li Xiaobo as envoy. Li spoke with Chief Clerk Zhang Chang of the pacification army and asked after Zhuang and Wang Hui—such was the reach of his reputation.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，除太子中庶子。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was appointed Crown Prince Vice Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 he was appointed vice censor to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 時南平王鑠獻赤鸚鵡，普詔群臣為賦。

translations.literal: At that time Prince of Nanping Shuo presented a crimson parrot, and an edict went out to all ministers to compose rhapsodies.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Prince Nanping Shuo presented a crimson parrot, and the court broadly ordered the ministers to compose rhapsodies on it.

sentences.zh: 太子左衛率袁淑文冠當時，作賦畢，齎以示莊；

translations.literal: Left Guard of the Crown Prince Yuan Shu was foremost in letters of the age; when he had finished his rhapsody he brought it to show Zhuang;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shu, left guard of the crown prince, was the leading writer of the day; when he had finished his rhapsody he brought it to show Zhuang;

sentences.zh: 莊賦亦竟，淑見而歎曰：「江東無我，卿當獨秀。

translations.literal: Zhuang's rhapsody was also finished; when Shu saw it he sighed and said: "Without me in the Jiangdong region, you would stand alone in excellence.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang's rhapsody was finished as well; when Shu read it he sighed and said, "Without me in the southeast, you would stand alone as the finest writer.

sentences.zh: 我若無卿，亦一時之傑也。」

translations.literal: If there were no you, I too would be a hero of the age."
translations.idiomatic: If you were not here, I would still rank among the finest of the age."

sentences.zh: 遂隱其賦。

translations.literal: He then concealed his own rhapsody.
translations.idiomatic: He then hid his own rhapsody and did not submit it.

sentences.zh: 元兇弑立，轉司徒左長史。

translations.literal: When the usurper Shao seized the throne by regicide, Zhuang was transferred to Left Chief Clerk of the Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: After the usurper Shao murdered his father and seized the throne, Zhuang was made left chief clerk of the minister of education.

sentences.zh: 世祖入討，密送檄書與莊，令加改治宣佈。

translations.literal: When the Heir Apparent entered to punish the usurper, he secretly sent a proclamation to Zhuang ordering him to revise and polish it for publication.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu marched in to suppress the usurper, he secretly sent Zhuang the proclamation and ordered him to revise and polish it for public announcement.

sentences.zh: 莊遣腹心門生具慶奉啟事密詣世祖曰：「賊劭自絕於天，裂冠毀冕，窮弑極逆，開闢未聞，四海泣血，幽明同憤。

translations.literal: Zhuang sent his trusted student Ju Qing to deliver a memorial in secret to the Heir Apparent, saying: "The rebel Shao has cut himself off from Heaven, torn the crown and destroyed the regalia, pursued regicide to the utmost in extreme treason—unheard of since the opening of the age; the Four Seas weep blood, the hidden and the manifest share one wrath.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang sent his trusted student Ju Qing with a secret memorial to the heir apparent, saying, "The rebel Shao has cut himself off from Heaven, defiled the crown and regalia, and carried regicide to the utmost pitch of treason—such a crime has never been heard of since the world began; all under heaven weep blood, and the living and the dead alike burn with outrage.

sentences.zh: 奉三月二十七日檄，聖跡昭然，伏讀感慶。

translations.literal: Having received the proclamation of the twenty-seventh day of the third month, the sage's traces are manifest; bowing in reading I am moved to rejoicing.
translations.idiomatic: I have received the proclamation of the twenty-seventh day of the third month; your sacred purpose shines clear, and reading it prostrate I am moved to joy and gratitude.

sentences.zh: 天祚王室，叡哲重光。

translations.literal: Heaven blesses the royal house; sagely wisdom shines anew.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven blesses the royal house, and sagely wisdom shines forth once more.

sentences.zh: 殿下文明在嶽，神武居陝，肅將乾威，龔行天罰，滌社稷之仇，雪華夷之恥，使弛墜之構，更獲締造，垢辱之氓，復得明目。

translations.literal: Your Highness's civil brilliance rests on the mountain, divine martial power dwells in Shaan; solemnly you marshal the authority of Heaven, reverently execute Heaven's punishment, wash away the state's enmity, wipe clean the shame of Chinese and barbarian alike, so that a structure grown slack may be newly bound together, and people stained with disgrace may again open their eyes to the light.
translations.idiomatic: Your Highness's civil brilliance towers like a mountain, your divine martial power holds the center; solemnly you marshal Heaven's authority and reverently carry out Heaven's punishment, cleansing the state's wrongs and wiping away the shame of court and frontier alike, so that a realm grown slack may be bound anew and a people sunk in dishonor may once more see the light.

sentences.zh: 伏承所命，柳元景、司馬文恭、宗愨、沈慶之等精甲十萬，已次近道。

translations.literal: I humbly receive your orders: Liu Yuanjing, Sima Wengong, Zong Que, Shen Qingzhi, and others with a hundred thousand elite armored troops have already encamped on the near road.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly learn of your command: Liu Yuanjing, Sima Wengong, Zong Que, Shen Qingzhi, and others at the head of a hundred thousand elite armored troops have already halted on the roads nearby.

sentences.zh: 殿下親董銳旅，授律繼進。

translations.literal: Your Highness personally directs the sharp troops, sets the law of war, and advances in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Your Highness personally leads the crack troops, sets the rules of war, and presses forward in their wake.

sentences.zh: 荊、鄢之師，岷、漢之眾，舳艫萬里，旌斾虧天，九土冥符，群後畢會。

translations.literal: Armies of Jing and Yan, hosts of Min and Han, war vessels for ten thousand li, banners and pennants eclipsing the sky—the nine regions darkly align, all the lords assemble as one.
translations.idiomatic: Armies from Jing and Yan, hosts from Min and Han, war fleets stretching a thousand miles, banners blotting out the sky—the nine provinces answer as one, and all the lords gather in full muster.

sentences.zh: 今獨夫醜類，曾不盈旅，自相暴殄，省闥橫流，百僚屏氣，道路以目。

translations.literal: Now the lone villain and his vile kind number scarcely a full brigade; they destroy one another, blood flows across the palace gates, the hundred officials hold their breath, and men in the road exchange glances in silence.
translations.idiomatic: Now the usurper and his vile crew can scarcely fill a single camp; they tear one another apart, blood flows across the palace gates, the hundred officials hold their breath, and men in the streets dare only look at one another in silence.

sentences.zh: 檄至，輒布之京邑，朝野同欣，裏頌途歌，室家相慶，莫不望景聳魂，瞻雲佇足。

translations.literal: When the proclamation arrives it is at once posted in the capital; court and countryside rejoice alike, lanes resound with praise and roads with song, households celebrate one another—none fail to lift their souls at the sight of your banner or stand on tiptoe gazing toward your cloud-borne standard.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as the proclamation arrives it is posted through the capital; court and countryside rejoice together, lanes ring with praise and roads with song, and families celebrate in every home—all lift their hearts at the sight of your standard and stand on tiptoe watching for your approach.

sentences.zh: 先帝以日月之光，照臨區宇，風澤所漸，無幽不洽。

translations.literal: The late emperor with the light of sun and moon illumined the realm; where his wind and grace penetrated, none in the darkest corner was left unreached.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor shone upon the realm like sun and moon; wherever his grace and favor reached, no corner however remote was left untouched.

sentences.zh: 況下官世荷寵靈，叨恩逾量，謝病私門，倖免虎口，雖志在投報，其路無由。

translations.literal: How much more so your humble servant, who for generations has received favor and blessing, who has enjoyed grace beyond measure, who retired ill to his private gate and by luck escaped the tiger's maw—though my will is set on repaying you, I have no road by which to do it.
translations.idiomatic: How much more so I, who for generations have received your house's favor, who have enjoyed grace beyond my deserts, who retired sick to my home and by fortune escaped the tiger's jaws—though my heart is set on repaying you, I have no means to do so.

sentences.zh: 今大軍近次，永清無遠，欣悲踴躍，不知所裁。」

translations.literal: Now the great army halts nearby; lasting peace is not far off. Joy and grief surge within me; I know not how to contain myself."
translations.idiomatic: Now the great army is encamped nearby and lasting peace is close at hand; joy and sorrow overwhelm me, and I scarcely know how to bear it."

sentences.zh: 世祖踐阼，除侍中。

translations.literal: When the Heir Apparent ascended the throne, Zhuang was appointed Attendant-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu took the throne, Zhuang was appointed attendant-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 時索虜求通互市，上詔群臣博議。

translations.literal: At that time the northern barbarians requested mutual border markets; the emperor ordered the ministers to debate the matter broadly.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the northern enemies asked to open mutual border markets, and the emperor ordered a broad debate among the ministers.

sentences.zh: 莊議曰：「臣愚以為獯獫棄義，唯利是視，關市之請，或以覘國，順之示弱，無明柔遠，距而觀釁，有足表強。

translations.literal: Zhuang argued: "Your servant is foolish and holds that the Xianyun abandon righteousness and look only to profit; their request for border markets may be to spy on the state. To comply is to show weakness and lacks the clarity of winning the distant by gentleness; to refuse and watch for provocation is enough to display strength.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang argued, "In my foolish view the northern tribes abandon righteousness and care only for profit; their request for border markets may be a pretext to spy on our state. To agree would show weakness and would not embody the policy of winning distant peoples through kindness; to refuse and watch for trouble is enough to display our strength.

sentences.zh: 且漢文和親，豈止彭陽之寇；

translations.literal: Moreover, when Emperor Wen of Han made peace marriages, did that stop raids beyond Pengyang alone?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when Emperor Wen of Han pursued marriage alliances, did that end raids beyond Pengyang alone?

sentences.zh: 武帝修約，不廢馬邑之謀。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu renewed treaties he did not abandon the stratagem of Mayi.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu renewed treaties he still did not abandon the stratagem of Mayi.

sentences.zh: 故有餘則經略，不足則閉關。

translations.literal: Thus when resources suffice one campaigns abroad; when they do not, one closes the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Thus when strength suffices one campaigns abroad; when it does not, one closes the frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 何為屈冠帶之邦，通引弓之俗，樹無益之軌，招塵點之風。

translations.literal: Why should a realm of caps and belts bow to bow-drawing customs, plant a track of no benefit, and invite a wind of dust and stain?
translations.idiomatic: Why should a civilized state bow to bow-shooting barbarians, establish a precedent of no benefit, and invite a stain upon our honor?

sentences.zh: 交易爽議，既應深杜；

translations.literal: The proposal for trade should deeply be blocked;
translations.idiomatic: The proposal for trade should be firmly rejected;

sentences.zh: 和約詭論，尤宜固絕。

translations.literal: deceptive talk of peace treaties should especially be firmly cut off.
translations.idiomatic: and deceptive talk of peace treaties should especially be firmly rejected.

sentences.zh: 臣庸管多蔽，豈識國儀，恩誘降逮，敢不披盡。」

translations.literal: Your servant's narrow tube sees much in shadow and little of state ritual; yet your grace draws me down and reaches me—how dare I not lay bare my utmost thoughts."
translations.idiomatic: I am narrow in vision and scarcely understand state policy, yet your grace draws me onward—how dare I not speak my mind fully."

sentences.zh: 時驃騎將軍竟陵王誕當為荊州，徵丞相、荊州刺史南郡王義宣入輔，義宣固辭不入，而誕便克日下船。

translations.literal: At that time General of Agile Cavalry Prince of Jingling Dan was to take Jing Province; the Chancellor and Governor of Jing Province Prince of Nanjun Yixuan was summoned to enter as regent. Yixuan firmly declined and would not enter, while Dan had already set a day to board ship.
translations.idiomatic: At that time General of Agile Cavalry Prince Jingling Dan was to take Jing Province, while Chancellor and Jing governor Prince Nanjun Yixuan was summoned to enter the capital as regent. Yixuan firmly refused to come, yet Dan had already fixed a day to embark.

sentences.zh: 莊以丞相既無入志，驃騎發便有期，如似欲相逼切，於事不便。

translations.literal: Zhuang held that since the Chancellor already had no will to enter, and the General of Agile Cavalry's departure had a fixed date, it seemed as if one wished to press the other—this was inconvenient for affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang held that since the chancellor clearly had no intention of coming while the general's departure was already fixed, it looked as though one side was pressing the other—a course ill suited to the situation.

sentences.zh: 世祖乃申誕發日，義宣竟亦不下。

translations.literal: The emperor then postponed Dan's departure date, and Yixuan in the end also did not embark.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then postponed Dan's departure, and in the end Yixuan did not embark either.

sentences.zh: 上始踐阼，欲宣弘風則，下節儉詔書，事在《孝武本紀》。

translations.literal: When the emperor first ascended the throne he wished to proclaim lofty standards of conduct and issued an edict on frugality; the matter is recorded in the Basic Annals of Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor first took the throne he wished to proclaim lofty standards and issued an edict on frugality; the matter is recorded in the Basic Annals of Emperor Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 莊慮此制不行，又言曰：「詔云『貴戚競利，興貨廛肆者，悉皆禁制』。

translations.literal: Zhuang feared this measure would not be carried out and spoke again: "The edict says, 'Nobles and kin who compete for profit and set up shops to trade goods—all are to be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang feared the measure would not be enforced and spoke again: "The edict says, 'Nobles and imperial kin who compete for profit and open shops to trade—all such activity is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 此實允愜民聽。

translations.literal: This truly accords with what the people wish to hear.
translations.idiomatic: This truly accords with what the people wish to hear.

sentences.zh: 其中若有犯違，則應依制裁糾；

translations.literal: If among them there are violators, they should be investigated and punished according to the statutes;
translations.idiomatic: If any violate it, they should be investigated and punished under the law;

sentences.zh: 若廢法申恩，便為令有所屈。

translations.literal: if the law is set aside to extend favor, then the command itself is bent.
translations.idiomatic: if the law is set aside to show favor, the edict itself is compromised.

sentences.zh: 此處分伏願深思，無緣明詔既下，而聲實乖爽。

translations.literal: On this disposition I humbly beg deep reflection: there is no reason why, once a clear edict has been issued, its reputation and reality should diverge.
translations.idiomatic: On this point I beg deep reflection: once a clear edict has been issued, word and deed must not diverge.

sentences.zh: 臣愚謂大臣在祿位者，尤不宜與民爭利，不審可得在此詔不？

translations.literal: Your servant is foolish and holds that great ministers who hold salary and office should especially not compete with the people for profit—might they be included within this edict?
translations.idiomatic: In my foolish view great ministers on salary should especially not compete with the people for profit—can they be included within this edict?

sentences.zh: 拔葵去織，實宜深弘。」

translations.literal: To uproot the mallow and banish the weaving woman—this truly should be deeply proclaimed."
translations.idiomatic: The example of uprooting the mallow and banishing the weaving woman should truly be upheld in full."

sentences.zh: 臣聞功照千里，非特燭車之珍；

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that merit that shines a thousand li is not merely the treasure of a candle-cart;
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that merit that shines a thousand li is not merely the treasure of a candle-cart;

sentences.zh: 德柔鄰國，豈徒秘璧之貴，故《詩》稱殄悴，《誓》述榮懷，用能道臻無積，化至恭己。

translations.literal: virtue that softens neighboring states is not only the worth of a secret jade disk. Thus the Odes speak of exhausting care, the Documents tell of glory embraced—by this the Way reaches where nothing piles up, and transformation arrives at holding oneself in reverence.
translations.idiomatic: virtue that wins over neighboring states is not only the worth of a secret jade. Thus the Odes praise tireless care and the Documents describe glory embraced—by this the Way reaches where nothing piles up, and transformation arrives at self-restraint.

sentences.zh: 伏惟陛下膺慶集圖，締宇開縣，夕爽選政，昃旦調風，采言廝輿，觀謠仄遠，斯實辰階告平，頌聲方制。

translations.literal: I humbly consider that Your Majesty has received felicity and gathered the mandate, bound the realm and opened the counties, in the evening refreshed in choosing government, at dusk and dawn tuning the wind, gathering words from the common cart, observing songs from the distant lanes—this truly is the hour when the steps announce peace and praise-songs are just taking form.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly consider that Your Majesty has received Heaven's blessing and gathered the mandate, bound the realm and opened the counties, refreshes governance evening by evening and tunes the moral wind from dusk till dawn, gathers words from common carts and heeds songs from distant lanes—truly the hour when the age announces peace and praise-songs are just taking shape.

sentences.zh: 臣竊惟隆陂所漸，治亂之由，何嘗不興資得才，替因失士。

translations.literal: Your servant privately reflects that what the high dyke gradually receives— the causes of order and chaos—when has rise not depended on gaining talent, or decline on losing scholars?
translations.idiomatic: I reflect privately that what the high dyke gradually receives—the causes of order and chaos—when has rise not depended on gaining talent, or decline on losing worthy men?

sentences.zh: 故楚書以善人為寶，《虞典》以則哲為難。

translations.literal: Thus the book of Chu takes good men as treasure, and the Canon of Yu calls discerning the wise the hard task.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the book of Chu takes good men as treasure, and the Canon of Yu calls discerning the wise the hard task.

sentences.zh: 進選之軌，既弛中代，登造之律，未闡當今。

translations.literal: The track of advancement and selection has already slackened since the middle age; the law of elevation and appointment has not been opened in the present day.
translations.idiomatic: The path of advancement and selection has slackened since the middle dynasties, and the law of elevation and appointment has not been clarified in our own day.

sentences.zh: 必欲崇本康務，庇民濟俗，匪更惉懘，奚取九成。

translations.literal: If one must exalt the root and bring peace to affairs, shelter the people and aid custom—without renewing the ninefold music, how take the nine accomplishments?
translations.idiomatic: If one must exalt the root, bring peace to affairs, shelter the people, and aid custom—without renewing the ninefold harmonies, how attain the nine accomplishments?

sentences.zh: 升曆中陽，英賢起於徐、沛；

translations.literal: When the calendar rose at Zhongyang, heroes and worthies arose from Xu and Pei;
translations.idiomatic: When the calendar rose at Zhongyang, heroes and worthies arose from Xu and Pei;

sentences.zh: 受籙白水，茂異出於荊、宛。

translations.literal: when the mandate was received at Baishui, splendid talents came forth from Jing and Wan.
translations.idiomatic: when the mandate was received at Baishui, splendid talents came forth from Jing and Wan.

sentences.zh: 寧二都智之所產，七諲愚之所集，實遇與不遇，用與不用耳。

translations.literal: Were the two capitals alone producers of wisdom, and the seven backwaters alone gatherers of folly? In truth it is meeting or not meeting, employing or not employing.
translations.idiomatic: Were the two capitals alone producers of wisdom and the seven backwaters alone gatherers of folly? In truth it is a matter of being recognized or not, employed or not.

sentences.zh: 今大道光亨，萬務俟德，而九服之曠，九流之艱，提鈞懸衡，委之選部。

translations.literal: Now the great Way shines and prospers, ten thousand affairs await virtue—yet the vastness of the nine domains, the hardship of the nine streams, holding the weight and hanging the balance, is entrusted to the Selection Bureau alone.
translations.idiomatic: Now the great Way shines bright and ten thousand affairs await virtue—yet the vast realm and the hardship of every calling, holding the scales of judgment, are entrusted to the selection bureau alone.

sentences.zh: 一人之鑒易限，而天下之才難原；

translations.literal: one man's mirror is easily bounded, while the talent of all under Heaven is hard to fathom;
translations.idiomatic: One man's judgment is easily bounded, while the talent of all under Heaven is hard to fathom;

sentences.zh: 以易限之鑒，鏡難原之才，使國罔遺授，野無滯器，其可得乎？

translations.literal: to mirror hard-to-fathom talent with an easily bounded mirror—can the state leave no appointment unmade and the wilds no stalled vessel? Is that attainable?
translations.idiomatic: to judge unfathomable talent with a bounded mirror—can the state leave no post unfilled and the wilds no talent unused? Is that possible?

sentences.zh: 昔公叔與僎同升，管仲取臣於盜，趙文非親士疏嗣，祁奚豈諂讎比子，茹茅以匯，作範前經，舉爾所知，式昭往牒。

translations.literal: Of old Gongshu and Zao rose together; Guan Zhong took a minister from among robbers; Zhao Wen did not favor kin and kept scholars at a distance from heirs; how could Qi Xi flatter an enemy to compare with his son? Gathering rush and thatch to store them made a model in former classics—'Recommend those you know' shines forth in past records.
translations.idiomatic: Of old Gongshu and Zao rose together; Guan Zhong took a minister from among robbers; Zhao Wen did not favor kin and kept heirs distant from scholars; Qi Xi did not recommend an enemy to match his son. Gathering rush and thatch for storage became a model in former classics—'Recommend those you know' shines forth in past records.

sentences.zh: 且自古任薦，賞罰弘明，成子舉三哲而身致魏輔，應侯任二士而已捐秦相，臼季稱冀缺而疇以田采，張勃進陳湯而坐以褫爵。

translations.literal: Moreover, from antiquity responsibility for recommendation carried clear reward and punishment: Chengzi recommended three wise men and himself became Wei minister; Lord Ying entrusted two scholars and at once surrendered the Qin chancellorship; Jiuji praised Ji Que and was rewarded with fields; Zhang Bo advanced Chen Tang and sat by while his rank was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, from antiquity recommendation carried clear reward and punishment: Chengzi recommended three wise men and himself became minister of Wei; Lord Ying entrusted two scholars and at once gave up the Qin chancellorship; Jiuji praised Ji Que and was rewarded with fields; Zhang Bo advanced Chen Tang and sat by while his own rank was stripped.

sentences.zh: 此先事之盛准，亦後王之彝鑒。

translations.literal: These are the great standards of former affairs and also the constant mirrors of later kings.
translations.idiomatic: These are the great standards of former times and the constant mirrors for later kings.

sentences.zh: 如臣愚見，宜普命大臣，各舉所知，以付尚書，依分銓用。

translations.literal: In your servant's foolish view, a general order should go to great ministers, each to recommend those he knows, deliver them to the Secretariat, and employ them according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In my foolish view, the court should broadly order great ministers each to recommend those he knows, deliver the names to the secretariat, and employ them according to rank.

sentences.zh: 若任得其才，舉主延賞；

translations.literal: If the appointment gains the right talent, the recommender receives extended reward;
translations.idiomatic: If the appointee proves capable, the recommender receives extended reward;

sentences.zh: 有不稱職，宜及其坐。

translations.literal: if he is unfit for office, the recommender should share the punishment.
translations.idiomatic: if the appointee is unfit, the recommender should share the punishment.

sentences.zh: 重者免黜，輕者左遷，被舉之身，加以禁錮，年數多少，隨愆議制。

translations.literal: In serious cases dismissal; in light cases demotion. The person recommended should also be placed under restriction; the number of years should follow the fault as debated and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Serious cases merit dismissal, light cases demotion; the appointee should also be placed under restriction for a term fixed according to the fault.

sentences.zh: 若犯大辟，則任者刑論。

translations.literal: If the crime reaches capital punishment, the appointing official faces penal judgment.
translations.idiomatic: If the crime reaches capital punishment, the appointing official faces penal judgment.

sentences.zh: 又政平訟理，莫先親民，親民之要，實歸守宰。

translations.literal: Moreover, in leveling government and settling lawsuits, nothing comes before drawing near to the people; the key to drawing near the people truly rests with the prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in leveling government and settling lawsuits, nothing comes before drawing near to the people; the key to drawing near the people truly rests with prefects and magistrates.

sentences.zh: 故黃霸治潁川累稔，杜畿居河東歷載，或就加恩秩，或入崇輝寵。

translations.literal: Thus Huang Ba governed Yingchuan for many years, Du Ji dwelt in Hedong for years on end—some were promptly given added ranks of grace, others entered to receive lofty favor.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Huang Ba governed Yingchuan for many years and Du Ji held Hedong for years on end—some were promptly given added ranks of grace, others entered court to receive lofty favor.

sentences.zh: 今蒞民之職，自非公私必應代換者，宜遵六年之制，進獲章明庸墮，退得民不勤擾。

translations.literal: Now offices that preside over the people, unless public or private affairs absolutely require rotation, should follow the six-year rule: on advancement they gain clear marks of merit or demerit; on retirement the people are not wearied by disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: Now offices that preside over the people, unless public or private affairs absolutely require rotation, should follow the six-year rule: on advancement they gain clear marks of merit or demerit; on retirement the people are spared repeated disturbance.

sentences.zh: 如此則下無浮謬之愆，上靡棄能之累，考績之風載泰，楢薪之歌克昌。

translations.literal: Thus below there would be no fault of floating error, above no burden of abandoning ability; the wind of examining achievement would flourish greatly, and the song of gathering firewood would attain splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Thus below there would be no fault of empty promotion, above no burden of wasted talent; the wind of examining achievement would flourish, and the song of gathering firewood would rise in praise.

sentences.zh: 臣生屬亨路，身漸鴻猷，遂得奉詔左右，陳愚於側，敢露芻言，懼氛恆典。

translations.literal: Your servant was born in an age of prosperity, his person steeped in great design, and thus obtained to attend edicts at Your Majesty's side and lay foolish thoughts before you; I dare offer this hay-like speech, fearing it may cloud the constant canon.
translations.idiomatic: I was born in an age of prosperity and have been steeped in your great design; thus I attend your edicts at your side and lay foolish thoughts before you. I dare offer these humble words, fearing they may cloud the constant standards.

sentences.zh: 有詔莊表如此，可付外詳議，事不行。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Zhuang's memorial is as this; it may be sent outside for detailed deliberation." The proposal was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Zhuang's memorial is as this; send it out for detailed deliberation." The proposal was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 其年，拜吏部尚書。

translations.literal: That year he was appointed Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was appointed minister of the ministry of personnel.

sentences.zh: 莊素多疾，不願居選部，與大司馬江夏王義恭牋自陳，曰：

translations.literal: Zhuang had long been subject to many illnesses and did not wish to hold the Selection Office; he sent a letter of self-statement to Grand Marshal Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang had long been ill and did not wish to head the selection office; he sent a letter of self-statement to Grand Marshal Prince Jiangxia Yigong, saying:

sentences.zh: 下官凡人，非有達概異識，俗外之志，實因羸疾，常恐奄忽，故少來無意於人間，豈當有心於崇達邪。

translations.literal: Your humble servant is an ordinary man, without far-reaching vision or unusual understanding, without ambitions beyond the world; in truth because of frail illness I constantly fear sudden death, and thus for years have had no mind for worldly affairs—how should I harbor a heart set on lofty advancement?
translations.idiomatic: I am an ordinary man, without far-reaching vision or ambitions beyond the world; in truth my frail health makes me constantly fear sudden death, and for years I have had no taste for worldly affairs—how could I harbor ambition for lofty advancement?

sentences.zh: 頃年乘事回薄，遂果饕非次，既足貽誚明時，又亦取愧朋友。

translations.literal: In recent years, riding on shifting circumstances, I have in fact obtained excessive rank beyond measure—enough to bring reproach in a bright age and also shame among friends.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years, riding shifting circumstances, I have in fact obtained rank beyond my deserts—enough to bring reproach in this bright age and shame among friends.

sentences.zh: 前以聖道初開，未遑引退，及此諸夏事寧，方陳微請。

translations.literal: Previously, because the sage Way had just opened, I had no leisure to withdraw; now that affairs among the various Xia are settled, I at last present this modest request.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, because your sage rule had just begun, I had no leisure to withdraw; now that affairs within the realm are settled, I at last present this modest request.

sentences.zh: 欵志未伸，仍荷今授，被恩之始，具披寸心，非惟在己知尤，實懼塵穢彝序。

translations.literal: My sincere wish had not been fulfilled when I still received this present appointment; at the beginning of receiving grace I lay bare my inch of heart—not only knowing my own fault, but truly fearing to stain the constant order.
translations.idiomatic: My sincere wish had not been granted when I still received this present appointment; at the start of receiving your grace I lay bare my heart—not only knowing my own fault, but truly fearing to stain the proper order.

sentences.zh: 稟生多病，天下所悉，兩脅癖疾，殆與生俱，一月發動，不減兩三，每至一惡，痛來逼心，氣餘如綖。

translations.literal: I was born with many illnesses, known to all under Heaven; pain in both flanks, a chronic affliction almost coeval with my birth—each month it strikes no fewer than two or three times; whenever a bout comes, pain presses on the heart and breath remains like a thread.
translations.idiomatic: I was born with many illnesses, as all know; pain in both flanks, a chronic affliction almost from birth—each month it strikes at least two or three times, and whenever a bout comes pain presses on my heart and my breath hangs by a thread.

sentences.zh: 利患數年，遂成痼疾，吸吸惙惙，常如行尸。

translations.literal: For several years the affliction has grown worse until it became a fixed disease; gasping and faint, I am constantly like a walking corpse.
translations.idiomatic: For several years the affliction has worsened into a fixed disease; gasping and faint, I am constantly like a walking corpse.

sentences.zh: 恆居死病，而不復道者，豈是疾痊，直以荷恩深重，思答殊施，牽課尪瘵，以綜所忝。

translations.literal: That I constantly dwell in mortal illness yet do not speak of it again—is it because the illness is cured? It is simply that, bearing deep grace, I think to repay extraordinary favor and drag my wasted frame through the duties I have been given.
translations.idiomatic: That I constantly dwell in mortal illness yet do not speak of it again—is it because I am cured? It is simply that, bearing your deep grace, I think to repay extraordinary favor and drag my wasted frame through the duties I have been given.

sentences.zh: 眼患五月來便不復得夜坐，恆閉帷避風日，晝夜惽懵，為此不復得朝謁諸王，慶吊親舊，唯被敕見，不容停耳。

translations.literal: For five months my eye ailment has made it impossible to sit up at night; I constantly close curtains to avoid wind and sun, dazed day and night. For this I can no longer attend court to visit the princes or offer congratulations and condolences to kin and friends—only when summoned by edict may I appear, without pause.
translations.idiomatic: For five months my eye ailment has made it impossible to sit up at night; I constantly close my curtains against wind and sun and am dazed day and night. For this I can no longer attend court to visit the princes or offer congratulations and condolences to kin and friends—I appear only when summoned by edict, without pause.

sentences.zh: 此段不堪見賓，已數十日，持此苦生，而使銓綜九流，應對無方之訴，實由聖慈罔已，然當之信自苦劇。

translations.literal: In this stretch I cannot bear to see guests and it has already been several tens of days; bearing this bitter life yet made to weigh and judge the nine streams and answer boundless petitions—it truly comes from imperial compassion without limit, yet undertaking it is in truth bitter beyond measure.
translations.idiomatic: For many days now I have been unable to receive guests; bearing this bitter life yet made to weigh and judge every calling and answer boundless petitions—it truly comes from your boundless compassion, yet undertaking it is bitter beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 若才堪事任，而體氣休健，承寵異之遇，處自效之途，豈苟欲思閑辭事邪！

translations.literal: If my talent matched the task and my body and breath were sound, receiving exceptional favor and standing on the path of self-devotion—how would I casually wish to think of leisure and decline office?
translations.idiomatic: If my talent matched the task and my body were sound, receiving exceptional favor and standing on the path of service—how would I casually wish to seek leisure and decline office?

sentences.zh: 家素貧弊，宅舍未立，兒息不免麤糲，而安之若命，寧復是能忘微祿，正以復有切於此處，故無復他願耳。

translations.literal: My family has long been poor and straitened, the house not yet built, my sons and children cannot escape coarse fare—yet I accept it as fate. Could I truly be one who forgets a modest salary? It is simply that there is something urgent in this post, and thus I have no other wish.
translations.idiomatic: My family has long been poor, our house not yet built, my children cannot escape coarse fare—yet I accept it as fate. Could I truly forget a modest salary? It is simply that something urgent binds me to this post, and thus I have no other wish.

sentences.zh: 今之所希，唯在小閑。

translations.literal: What I now desire is only a little leisure.
translations.idiomatic: What I now desire is only a little leisure.

sentences.zh: 下官微命，於天下至輕，在己不能不重。

translations.literal: A humble office and slight command are lightest in all under Heaven, yet to oneself they cannot but weigh heavy.
translations.idiomatic: A humble office and slight command are among the lightest matters in the realm, yet to me they weigh heavily.

sentences.zh: 屢經披請，未蒙哀恕，良由誠淺辭訥，不足上感。

translations.literal: I have repeatedly laid bare my request yet not received compassionate release—truly because my sincerity is shallow and my words clumsy, insufficient to move Your Majesty above.
translations.idiomatic: I have repeatedly laid bare my request yet not received compassionate release—truly because my sincerity is shallow and my words clumsy, insufficient to move you.

sentences.zh: 家世無年，亡高祖四十，曾祖三十二，亡祖四十七，下官新歲便三十五，加以疾患如此，當復幾時見聖世，就其中煎憹若此，實在可矜。

translations.literal: My family has no long years: the late great-grandfather died at forty, the late grandfather at thirty-two, the late grandfather at forty-seven; your humble servant in the new year will already be thirty-five. Added to illness such as this, how much longer can I see the sage age? That amid this I am tormented so—truly it warrants pity.
translations.idiomatic: My family has no long years: my great-grandfather died at forty, my grandfather at thirty-two, my father at forty-seven; in the new year I will already be thirty-five. With illness such as this, how much longer can I see this sage age? That amid this I am tormented so truly warrants pity.

sentences.zh: 前時曾啟願三吳，敕旨云「都不須復議外出」。

translations.literal: Earlier I once petitioned wishing for the Three Wu region; the edict said, "Do not discuss going out again at all."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier I once petitioned to be sent to the Three Wu region; the edict said, "Do not discuss going out again at all."

sentences.zh: 莫非過恩，然亦是下官生運，不應見一閒逸。

translations.literal: None of this was not excessive grace—yet it is also your humble servant's lot in life that he ought not to see a single moment of leisure.
translations.idiomatic: All of this was excessive grace—yet it is also my lot in life that I ought not to see a single moment of leisure.

sentences.zh: 今不敢復言此，當付之來生耳。

translations.literal: Now I dare not speak of this again; it must be entrusted to the next life.
translations.idiomatic: Now I dare not speak of this again; I must entrust it to the next life.

sentences.zh: 但得保餘年，無復物務，少得養痾，此便是志願永畢。

translations.literal: If I may only preserve my remaining years, have no further worldly duties, and gain a little time to nurse my illness—this would be the fulfillment of my will forever.
translations.idiomatic: If I may only preserve my remaining years, be free of worldly duties, and gain a little time to nurse my illness—that would fulfill my life's wish.

sentences.zh: 在衡門下有所懷，動止必聞，亦無假居職，患於不能裨補萬一耳。

translations.literal: Dwelling beneath a simple gate, if I have thoughts they will surely be heard in my comings and goings; there is also no pretense in holding office—I only fear being unable to aid the least fraction of ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Dwelling at home, if I have thoughts they will surely be known in all I do; there is no pretense in holding office—I only fear being unable to serve you in the least degree.

sentences.zh: 識淺才常，羸疾如此，孤負主上擢授之恩，私心實自哀愧。

translations.literal: My understanding is shallow and talent ordinary; with frail illness such as this I have failed the sovereign's grace in raising and appointing me—in private I truly grieve and feel shame.
translations.idiomatic: My understanding is shallow and talent ordinary; with frail illness such as this I have failed your grace in raising and appointing me—in private I truly grieve and feel shame.

sentences.zh: 入年便當更申前請，以死自固。

translations.literal: When the year enters I shall again present my former request, holding fast with my life.
translations.idiomatic: When the new year comes I shall again present my former request, and hold to it with my life.

sentences.zh: 但庸近所訴，恐未能仰徹。

translations.literal: But what I, mediocre and shallow, have stated in my petition—I fear it may not reach upward and penetrate fully.
translations.idiomatic: But in this shallow, clumsy plea of mine, I fear my meaning may not fully reach you.

sentences.zh: 公恩盼弘深，粗照誠懇，願侍坐言次，賜垂拯助，則苦誠至心，庶獲哀允。

translations.literal: Your Grace's favor is boundless and deep; it has roughly illumined my sincere earnestness. I wish to attend at your seat and speak in turn, and be granted rescue and aid—then my bitter sincerity and utmost heart might perhaps obtain compassionate approval.
translations.idiomatic: Your boundless grace has barely shone upon my sincere appeal; I wish to attend you in person and speak directly, and ask for your rescue and aid—then this bitter plea from my heart might perhaps win your compassionate consent.

sentences.zh: 若不蒙降祐，下官當於何希冀邪？

translations.literal: If I do not receive your descending blessing, what can your humble servant hope for?
translations.idiomatic: If I do not receive your gracious aid, what hope remains for me?

sentences.zh: 仰憑愍察，願不垂恡。

translations.literal: Relying upon your compassionate scrutiny, I hope you will not withhold.
translations.idiomatic: I rely upon your compassionate judgment and hope you will not withhold your mercy.

sentences.zh: 三年，坐辭疾多，免官。

translations.literal: In the third year, because he had often cited illness, he was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, because he had repeatedly pleaded illness, he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 大明元年，起為都官尚書，奏改定刑獄，曰：

translations.literal: In the first year of Daming, he was recalled as Minister of Justice and memorialized to reform criminal prisons, saying:
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daming, he was recalled as minister of justice and memorialized to reform the penal system, saying:

sentences.zh: 臣聞明慎用刑，厥存姬典；

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that wise and careful use of punishment is preserved in the Zhou classic;
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that wise and careful use of punishment is preserved in the Zhou classic;

sentences.zh: 哀矜折獄，實暉呂命。

translations.literal: compassion and pity in judging cases truly honor the mandate of Lü.
translations.idiomatic: compassion and pity in judging cases truly honor the mandate recorded in the Punishments of Lü.

sentences.zh: 罪疑從輕，既前王之格範；

translations.literal: When guilt is doubtful, lean toward leniency—this is already the standard of former kings;
translations.idiomatic: When guilt is doubtful, lean toward leniency—this is already the standard of former kings;

sentences.zh: 寧失弗經，亦列聖之恆訓。

translations.literal: better to let the guilty go than to kill the innocent—this too is the constant teaching of successive sages.
translations.idiomatic: better to release the guilty than execute the innocent—this too is the constant teaching of successive sages.

sentences.zh: 用能化致升平，道臻恭己。

translations.literal: Thus they were able to transform and attain ascending peace, and the Way reached self-restraint.
translations.idiomatic: By this means they transformed the realm and attained peace, and the Way reached the virtue of self-restraint.

sentences.zh: 逮漢文傷不辜之罰，除相坐之令，孝宣倍深文之吏，立鞫訊之法，當是時也，號令刑存。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Han grieved over punishment of the innocent and abolished the law of mutual implication, and Emperor Xuan doubled down on harsh legal officials and established interrogation procedures—at that time, decrees and punishments both stood firm.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Han grieved over the punishment of the innocent and abolished mutual implication, and Emperor Xuan confronted harsh legalists and established interrogation procedures—at that time both decrees and punishments stood in proper balance.

sentences.zh: 陛下踐位，親臨聽訟，億兆相賀，以為無冤民矣。

translations.literal: Your Majesty, upon ascending the throne, personally attended to hearing lawsuits; the hundred millions congratulated one another, thinking there would be no wronged people.
translations.idiomatic: When Your Majesty ascended the throne and personally heard lawsuits, the people everywhere congratulated one another, believing there would be no more wronged subjects.

sentences.zh: 而比囹圄未虛，頌聲尚缺。

translations.literal: Yet recently the prisons are not empty, and songs of praise are still lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Yet lately the prisons are still not empty, and praise for your rule has not yet fully risen.

sentences.zh: 臣竊謂五聽之慈，弗宣於宰物；

translations.literal: Your servant privately considers that the compassion of the five hearings is not proclaimed in governing the realm;
translations.idiomatic: I privately consider that the compassion of the five hearings has not been fully proclaimed in governing the realm;

sentences.zh: 三宥之澤，未洽於民謠。

translations.literal: the grace of the three pardons has not permeated the people's songs.
translations.idiomatic: and the grace of the three pardons has not yet reached the people's songs.

sentences.zh: 頃年軍旅餘弊，劫掠猶繁，監司計獲，多非其實。

translations.literal: In recent years the aftereffects of military campaigns remain; robbery and plunder are still frequent, and supervisory officials count captures—many of which are not real.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the aftereffects of war linger; robbery and plunder remain frequent, and supervisory officials tally arrests—many of which are false.

sentences.zh: 或規免咎，不慮國患，楚對之下，鮮不誣濫。

translations.literal: Some scheme to avoid blame and give no thought to harm to the state; under Chu-style interrogation, scarcely any case is free of false charges and abuse.
translations.idiomatic: Some seek only to escape blame and give no thought to the harm done the state; under harsh interrogation, scarcely any case is free of false charges and abuse.

sentences.zh: 身遭鈇鑕之誅，家嬰孥戮之痛，比伍同閈，莫不及罪。

translations.literal: Bodies suffer execution by axe and halberd, families encounter the pain of wives and children put to death; neighbors in the same ward and lane—none escape punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Men suffer execution by axe and halberd, families endure the slaughter of wives and children, and neighbors in the same ward and lane—none escape punishment.

sentences.zh: 是則一人罰謬，坐者數十。

translations.literal: Thus one person's wrongful punishment implicates dozens.
translations.idiomatic: Thus a single wrongful punishment can implicate dozens.

sentences.zh: 昔齊女告天，臨淄臺殞；

translations.literal: Formerly the Qi girl appealed to Heaven, and the Linzi tower collapsed;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the girl of Qi appealed to Heaven, and the tower at Linzi collapsed;

sentences.zh: 孝婦冤戮，東海愆陽，此皆符變靈祗，初咸景緯。

translations.literal: the filial wife was wrongfully executed, and drought afflicted Donghai—these all match transformations wrought by spirits and deities, all auguring celestial signs.
translations.idiomatic: a filial wife was wrongfully executed, and drought afflicted Donghai—these were all transformations wrought by spirits and deities, all auguries written in the heavens.

sentences.zh: 臣近兼訊，見重囚八人，旋觀其初，死有餘罪，詳察其理，實並無辜。

translations.literal: Your servant recently, while jointly examining cases, saw eight prisoners under sentence of death; at first glance they deserved death and more, but on careful examination of the principles, they were in fact all innocent.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, while jointly examining cases, I saw eight prisoners under sentence of death; at first glance they seemed richly deserving of death, but on careful examination they were in fact all innocent.

sentences.zh: 恐此等不少，誠可怵惕也。

translations.literal: I fear such cases are not few—truly something to dread and be vigilant about.
translations.idiomatic: I fear such cases are not few—truly a matter for dread and vigilance.

sentences.zh: 舊官長竟囚畢，郡遣督郵案驗，仍就施刑。

translations.literal: Formerly, when local officials finished trying prisoners, the commandery sent supervising clerks to verify the cases, then immediately carried out punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, when local officials finished trying prisoners, the commandery sent supervising clerks to verify the cases and then immediately carried out punishment.

sentences.zh: 督郵賤吏，非能異於官長，有案驗之名，而無研究之實。

translations.literal: Supervising clerks are lowly functionaries, no better than local officials; they have the name of case verification but not the reality of thorough investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising clerks are lowly functionaries, no more capable than local officials; they bear the title of verification but not the reality of thorough investigation.

sentences.zh: 愚謂此制宜革。

translations.literal: I foolishly consider that this institution should be reformed.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly consider that this institution should be reformed.

sentences.zh: 自今入重之囚，縣考正畢，以事言郡，並送囚身，委二千石親臨覈辯，必收聲吞釁，然後就戮。

translations.literal: From now on, for prisoners sentenced to heavy punishment: when the county investigation is complete, report the matter to the commandery and send the prisoner as well; entrust the two-thousand-dan official to verify and cross-examine in person—only when guilt is fully confessed and crimes acknowledged should execution proceed.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, for prisoners sentenced to heavy punishment: when the county investigation is complete, report the matter to the commandery and send the prisoner as well; the two-thousand-dan official should verify and cross-examine in person—only when guilt is fully confessed should execution proceed.

sentences.zh: 若二千石不能決，乃度廷尉。

translations.literal: If the two-thousand-dan official cannot decide, then refer the case to the Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: If the two-thousand-dan official cannot decide, the case should be referred to the minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 神州統外，移之刺史；

translations.literal: Outside the central provinces, refer the case to the provincial inspector;
translations.idiomatic: Outside the central provinces, refer the case to the provincial inspector;

sentences.zh: 刺史有疑，亦歸臺獄。

translations.literal: if the inspector has doubts, it should also be referred to the central court prison.
translations.idiomatic: if the inspector has doubts, the case should also be referred to the central court prison.

sentences.zh: 必令死者不怨，生者無恨。

translations.literal: This must ensure that the dead do not resent and the living harbor no grudge.
translations.idiomatic: This must ensure that the dead do not resent and the living harbor no grudge.

sentences.zh: 庶鬻棺之諺，輟歎於終古；

translations.literal: Perhaps the proverb of the coffin seller may cease its sighs through all ages;
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps the proverb of the coffin seller may cease its lament through all ages;

sentences.zh: 兩造之察，流詠於方今。

translations.literal: the scrutiny of both parties may flow in song in the present age.
translations.idiomatic: and scrutiny of both parties may be sung in praise in our own time.

sentences.zh: 臣學闇申、韓，才寡治術，輕陳庸管，懼乖國憲。

translations.literal: Your servant's learning is obscure in Shen and Han, my talent meager in statecraft; I lightly offer my foolish opinion, fearing to violate national statutes.
translations.idiomatic: My learning is obscure in the arts of Shen and Han, my talent meager in statecraft; I lightly offer this foolish opinion, fearing it may violate the statutes of the realm.

sentences.zh: 上時親覽朝政，常慮權移臣下，以吏部尚書選舉所由，欲輕其勢力。

translations.literal: At that time the Emperor personally oversaw court affairs and often worried that power would shift to subordinates; since the Minister of Personnel was the source of selection and appointment, he wished to reduce its influence.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor personally oversaw court affairs and often worried that power would shift to his ministers; since the minister of personnel controlled selection and appointment, he wished to reduce that office's influence.

sentences.zh: 二年，下詔曰：「八柄馭下，以爵為先；

translations.literal: In the second year an edict was issued, saying: "The eight handles for governing subordinates take ennoblement first;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year an edict was issued, saying, "The eight handles for governing subordinates take ennoblement first;

sentences.zh: 九德咸事，政典居首。

translations.literal: the nine virtues all serve affairs, and the governmental canon holds the foremost place.
translations.idiomatic: the nine virtues all serve the state, and the governmental canon holds the foremost place.

sentences.zh: 銓衡治樞，興替攸寄。

translations.literal: The scales of selection are the pivot of governance; rise and fall depend upon them.
translations.idiomatic: The scales of selection are the pivot of governance; rise and fall depend upon them.

sentences.zh: 頃世以來，轉失厥序，徒秉國鈞，終貽權謗。

translations.literal: In recent generations the proper order has increasingly been lost; merely holding the state balance, one ultimately invites slander over power.
translations.idiomatic: In recent generations the proper order has increasingly been lost; merely holding the balance of state, one ultimately invites slander over power.

sentences.zh: 今南北多士，勳勤彌積，物情善否，實繫斯任。

translations.literal: Now worthies abound north and south, merit and diligence accumulate ever more—the people's judgment of good and bad truly hinges on this office.
translations.idiomatic: Now men of talent abound north and south, merit and diligence accumulate ever more—the people's judgment of good and bad truly hinges on this office.

sentences.zh: 官人之詠，維聖克允；

translations.literal: The people's song about appointing officers—only the sage can fulfill it;
translations.idiomatic: The people's song about appointing officers—only a sage can fulfill it;

sentences.zh: 則哲之美，粵帝所難。

translations.literal: the beauty of discerning the wise—this is what emperors find hardest.
translations.idiomatic: the beauty of discerning the wise—this is what emperors find hardest.

sentences.zh: 加澆季在俗，讓議成風，以一人之識，當群品之誚，望沈浮自得，庸可致乎！

translations.literal: Added to this, a degenerate age is in the customs and yielding debate has become the fashion—how can one person's judgment bear the blame of all ranks and hope to settle advancement and decline on his own? How can this be achieved!
translations.idiomatic: Added to this, the age is degenerate and yielding debate has become the fashion—how can one person's judgment bear the blame of all ranks and hope to settle who rises and falls on his own? How can this be achieved!

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書可依郎分置，並詳省閑曹。」

translations.literal: The Minister of Personnel may be established according to bureau divisions, and idle offices carefully reduced.
translations.idiomatic: The minister of personnel may be established according to bureau divisions, and idle offices carefully reduced.

sentences.zh: 又別詔太宰江夏王義恭曰：

translations.literal: Again a separate edict to Grand Preceptor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong said:
translations.idiomatic: A separate edict was also issued to Grand Preceptor Prince Jiangxia Yigong, saying:

sentences.zh: 分選詔旦出，在朝論者，亦有同異。

translations.literal: "The edict on divided selection issued this morning—those in court who discuss it also have agreement and disagreement.
translations.idiomatic: "The edict on divided selection issued this morning—those at court who discuss it are also divided in opinion.

sentences.zh: 誠知循常甚易，改舊生疑。

translations.literal: I truly know that following custom is very easy, and changing old ways breeds doubt.
translations.idiomatic: I truly know that following custom is very easy, and changing old ways breeds doubt.

sentences.zh: 但吏部尚書由來與錄共選，良以一人之識，不辦洽通，兼與奪威權，不宜專一故也。

translations.literal: But the Minister of Personnel has from old jointly conducted selection with the Chief Recorder—truly because one person's judgment cannot manage comprehensive understanding, and because the power to grant and withhold should not be concentrated, for this reason.
translations.idiomatic: But the minister of personnel has from old jointly conducted selection with the chief recorder—truly because one person's judgment cannot grasp everything, and because the power to grant and withhold should not be concentrated.

sentences.zh: 前述宣先旨，敬從來奏，省錄作則，永貽後昆。

translations.literal: My earlier statement proclaimed the prior intent; respectfully following your former memorial, the Chief Recorder set the rule to be bequeathed forever to posterity.
translations.idiomatic: My earlier statement proclaimed the prior intent; respectfully following your former memorial, the chief recorder set the rule to be bequeathed to posterity.

sentences.zh: 自此選舉之要，唯由元、凱一人。

translations.literal: From then on the essentials of selection rested solely with Yuan and Kai as one.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the essentials of selection rested solely with Yuan and Kai acting as one.

sentences.zh: 若通塞乖衷，而訴達者鮮，且違令與物，理至隔閡。

translations.literal: If success and obstruction diverge from the right intent, and few can lodge complaints that reach through, moreover violating orders and public sentiment—the principle leads to estrangement.
translations.idiomatic: If success and obstruction diverge from what is right, and few complaints can reach the throne, moreover violating both orders and public sentiment—the result is estrangement.

sentences.zh: 前王盛主，猶或難之，況在寡闇，尤見其短。

translations.literal: Even former enlightened kings and sage rulers found this difficult; how much more for one dull and dim—especially would its flaws appear.
translations.idiomatic: Even former enlightened kings and sage rulers found this difficult; how much more for one as dull and dim as I—its flaws would appear all the more.

sentences.zh: 又選官裁病，即嗟誚滿道，人之四體，會盈有虛，旬日之間，便至怨詈，況實有假託，不由寢頓者邪！

translations.literal: Moreover, when appointment to office is curtailed for illness, sighs and blame fill the roads; a person's four limbs are sometimes full and sometimes empty—in a matter of ten days resentment and cursing arise; how much more when there are truly those who feign illness, not from bedridden exhaustion!"
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when appointment to office is curtailed for illness, sighs and blame fill the roads; a person's health waxes and wanes—in ten days resentment and cursing arise; how much more when some truly feign illness rather than suffer bedridden exhaustion!"

sentences.zh: 一詣不前，貧苦交困，則兩邊致患，互不相體，校之以實，並有可哀。

translations.literal: When one side does not advance to appointment, poverty and hardship compound—in both directions trouble arises, neither side understanding the other; measured against reality, both sides have cause for pity.
translations.idiomatic: When one side fails to advance to appointment, poverty and hardship compound—trouble arises on both sides, neither understanding the other; measured against reality, both sides deserve pity.

sentences.zh: 若職置二人，則無此弊。

translations.literal: If the office is set with two persons, then this flaw would not exist.
translations.idiomatic: If the office were held by two persons, this flaw would not exist.

sentences.zh: 兼選曹樞要，歷代斯重，人經此職，便成貴塗，己心外議，咸不自限，故范曄、魯爽，舉兵滅門。

translations.literal: Moreover the selection bureau is pivotal and has been weighty in every dynasty; once one passes through this office it becomes a path to eminence—in one's own mind and in outside opinion all fail to restrain themselves; thus Fan Ye and Lu Shuang raised armies and their clans were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the selection bureau is pivotal and has been weighty in every dynasty; once a man passes through this office it becomes a path to eminence—in his own mind and in public opinion he fails to restrain himself; thus Fan Ye and Lu Shuang raised armies and their clans were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 以此言之，實由榮厚勢驅，殷繁所至。

translations.literal: Speaking thus, it truly stems from glory and thick rewards driving power—where abundance leads.
translations.idiomatic: Speaking thus, it truly stems from glory and rich rewards driving power—where abundance leads.

sentences.zh: 設可擬議此授，唯有數人，本積歲月，稍加引進，而理無前期，多生慮表；

translations.literal: Even if one could consider candidates for this appointment, there are only a few persons; originally accumulated over years and gradually promoted—yet rationally there is no prior fixed term, and many outward concerns arise;
translations.idiomatic: Even if one could consider candidates for this appointment, there are only a few men; they are accumulated over years and gradually promoted—yet there is no fixed term in principle, and many outward concerns arise;

sentences.zh: 或嬰艱抱疾，事至回移。

translations.literal: some encounter hardships or hold illness, and when affairs arrive plans shift.
translations.idiomatic: some encounter hardship or fall ill, and when affairs arrive plans must shift.

sentences.zh: 官人之任，決不可闕，一來一去，向人已周，非有黜責，已貴難賤；

translations.literal: The task of appointing officers absolutely cannot be vacant; one comes, one goes—the roster is already complete; without dismissal or censure, one who is already eminent is hard to demote;
translations.idiomatic: The task of appointing officers absolutely cannot be left vacant; one man comes, one goes—the roster is already full; without dismissal or censure, a man already eminent is hard to demote;

sentences.zh: 既成妨長，置之無所，盛衰遞襲，便是一段世臣相處之方。

translations.literal: having already become an obstacle to advancement, with nowhere to place them—as rise and decline pass in turn, this becomes a whole generation's pattern for how hereditary ministers coexist.
translations.idiomatic: having already become an obstacle to others' advancement, with nowhere to place them—as rise and decline pass in turn, this becomes a whole generation's pattern for how hereditary ministers coexist.

sentences.zh: 臣主生疑，所以彌覺此職，宜在降階。

translations.literal: When lord and minister generate suspicion, for this reason I feel all the more that this office should be lowered in rank.
translations.idiomatic: When lord and minister generate suspicion, for this reason I feel all the more that this office should be lowered in rank.

sentences.zh: 監令端右，足處時望，無人則闕，異於九流。

translations.literal: Supervisors and commanders on the right flank suffice to meet contemporary expectations; if there is no one, leave it vacant—different from the nine ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisors and commanders on the right suffice to meet contemporary expectations; if there is no suitable man, leave the post vacant—different from the nine ranks.

sentences.zh: 今但直銓選部，有減前資。

translations.literal: Now merely directly handling the selection bureau—reduced from previous standing.
translations.idiomatic: Now merely directly handling the selection bureau—a reduction from previous standing.

sentences.zh: 物情好猜，橫立別解，本旨向意，終不外宣。

translations.literal: Public sentiment loves suspicion; arbitrarily setting up separate interpretations—the original intent and direction ultimately cannot be proclaimed outward.
translations.idiomatic: Public sentiment loves suspicion; arbitrarily setting up separate interpretations—the original intent ultimately cannot be proclaimed abroad.

sentences.zh: 唯有從郎分置，視聽自改。

translations.literal: Only by dividing according to bureau—what is seen and heard will change of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Only by dividing according to bureau will what is seen and heard change of itself.

sentences.zh: 選既輕先，民情已變，有堪其任，大展遷回。

translations.literal: Once selection is first lightened, public sentiment already changes; those capable of the task may be broadly rotated and advanced.
translations.idiomatic: Once selection is first lightened, public sentiment already changes; men capable of the task may be broadly rotated and advanced.

sentences.zh: 兼常之宜，以時稍進，本職非復重官可得，不須帶帖數過，居之盡無詒怪。

translations.literal: As for concurrent regular appointments, advance slightly with time; the primary office can no longer be obtained as a heavy post; no need to carry multiple concurrent titles repeatedly—holding it should entirely cause no reproach.
translations.idiomatic: As for concurrent regular appointments, advance them slightly with time; the primary office can no longer be obtained as a heavy post; there is no need to carry multiple concurrent titles repeatedly—holding it should cause no reproach at all.

sentences.zh: 自中分荊、揚，于時便有意於此，正訝改革不少，容生駭惑。

translations.literal: Since the division of Jing and Yang from the center, at that time I already had this intent; I was just surprised that reforms were not few, lest alarm and confusion arise.
translations.idiomatic: Since Jing and Yang were divided from the center, I already had this intent at the time; I was only surprised that the reforms were so numerous, lest alarm and confusion arise.

sentences.zh: 爾來多年，欲至歲下處分，會何偃致故，應有親人，故近因此施行。

translations.literal: For many years since, I wished to implement it at year's end; then He Yan passed away—there should be a trusted person, hence it was recently implemented for this reason.
translations.idiomatic: For many years since, I wished to implement it at year's end; then He Yan passed away—there should be a trusted man, hence it was recently implemented for this reason.

sentences.zh: 本意詔文不得委悉，故復紙墨具陳。

translations.literal: The original intent could not be fully conveyed in the edict text, hence again set forth in full on paper and ink.
translations.idiomatic: The original intent could not be fully conveyed in the edict text, hence it is again set forth in full here.

sentences.zh: 於是置吏部尚書二人，省五兵尚書，莊及度支尚書顧覬之竝補選職。

translations.literal: Thereupon two Ministers of Personnel were established, the Minister of Five Arms was abolished; Zhuang and Minister of Revenue Gu Yan were both appointed to selection duties.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon two ministers of personnel were established and the minister of five arms was abolished; Zhuang and Minister of Revenue Gu Yan were both appointed to selection duties.

sentences.zh: 遷右衛將軍，加給事中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to General of the Right Guards and added Attendant Within.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to general of the right guards and given the additional title of attendant within.

sentences.zh: 時河南獻舞馬，詔群臣為賦，莊所上其詞曰：

translations.literal: At that time Henan presented dancing horses; an edict ordered the ministers to compose rhapsodies, and the text Zhuang submitted read:
translations.idiomatic: At that time Henan presented dancing horses; an edict ordered the ministers to compose rhapsodies, and the text Zhuang submitted read:

sentences.zh: 天子馭三光，緫萬宇，挹雲經之留憲，裁河書之遺矩。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven drives the three luminaries and gathers the myriad realms, drawing from the lingering statutes of the Cloud Classic and trimming the surviving norms of the River Book.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven drives the three luminaries and gathers the myriad realms, drawing from the lingering statutes of the Cloud Classic and trimming the surviving norms of the River Book.

sentences.zh: 是以德澤上昭，天下漏泉，符瑞之慶咸屬，榮懷之應必躔。

translations.literal: Thus virtue's grace shines above, the realm below is like a spreading spring; auspicious omens and blessings all belong, and responses of glory and contentment surely align with the stars.
translations.idiomatic: Thus virtue's grace shines above and the realm below flows like a spreading spring; auspicious omens and blessings all gather, and responses of glory and contentment surely align with the stars.

sentences.zh: 月晷呈祥，乾維效氣，賦景河房，承靈天駟，陵原郊而漸影，躍采淵而泳質，辭水空而南傃，去輪臺而東洎，乘玉塞而歸寶，奄芝庭而獻秘。

translations.literal: The sundial presents auspicious signs, the heavenly axis exhales numinous breath; assigning splendor to the River Chamber, inheriting spirit from the Heavenly Team—crossing the suburban plain its shadow lengthens, leaping through colored depths its form swims; leaving the empty waters it turns south, departing from Luntai it drifts east; riding the jade frontier it returns with treasure, covering the terrace of ling it presents the secret.
translations.idiomatic: The sundial presents auspicious signs, the heavenly axis exhales numinous breath; splendor is assigned to the River Chamber, spirit inherited from the Heavenly Team—crossing the suburban plain its shadow lengthens, leaping through colored depths its form swims; leaving the empty waters it turns south, departing from Luntai it drifts east; riding the jade frontier it returns with treasure, covering the terrace of ling it presents the secret.

sentences.zh: 及其養安騏校，進駕龍涓，輝大馭於國皁，賁上襄於帝閑，超益野而逾綠地，軼蘭池而轢紫燕。

translations.literal: When it was nurtured in peace at the fine stable and entered the carriage behind the dragon reins, it shone the great chariot in the national stable and adorned Upper Xiang in the imperial stud; surpassing Yiye it crossed the green lands, outstripping Orchid Pool it crushed Purple Swallow.
translations.idiomatic: When it was nurtured in peace at the fine stable and entered the carriage behind the dragon reins, it shone the great chariot in the national stable and adorned Upper Xiang in the imperial stud; surpassing Yiye it crossed the green lands, outstripping Orchid Pool it crushed Purple Swallow.

sentences.zh: 五王晦其術，十氏懵其玄，東門豈或狀，西河不能傳。

translations.literal: The Five Kings obscure their arts, the Ten Clans are bewildered by their mystery; could East Gate ever describe it? River West could not transmit it.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Kings obscure their arts, the Ten Clans are bewildered by their mystery; could East Gate ever describe it? River West could not transmit it.

sentences.zh: 既秣苞以均性，又佩蘅以崇躅，卷雄神於綺文，蓄奔容於帷燭，蘊籋雲之銳景，戢追電之逸足，方疊熔於丹縞，亦聯規於朱駮。

translations.literal: Fed with millet for even temperament, adorned with orchids for lofty tracks, it rolls heroic spirit into brocade text and stores running form within curtain and candle; hoarding the sharp radiance of cloud-steeds, it restrains the flying feet that chase lightning; now layered in molten cinnabar stripes, now linked in pattern with vermilion dapples.
translations.idiomatic: Fed with millet for even temperament, adorned with orchids for lofty tracks, it rolls heroic spirit into brocade text and stores running form within curtain and candle; hoarding the sharp radiance of cloud-steeds, it restrains the flying feet that chase lightning; now layered in molten cinnabar stripes, now linked in pattern with vermilion dapples.

sentences.zh: 觀其雙璧應範，三封中圖，玄骨滿，燕室虛，陽理竟，潛策紆，汗飛赭，沫流朱。

translations.literal: Observing it: paired jade disks match the measure, three seals hit the target; dark bone fills, swallow chamber empties; yang principle ends, hidden tally twists; sweat flies cinnabar, foam flows vermilion.
translations.idiomatic: Observing it: paired jade disks match the measure, three seals hit the target; dark bone fills, swallow chamber empties; yang principle ends, hidden tally twists; sweat flies cinnabar, foam flows vermilion.

sentences.zh: 至於《肆夏》已升，《采齊》既薦，始徘徊而龍俛，終沃若而鸞眄，迎調露於飛鍾，赴承雲於驚箭，寫秦坰之彌塵，狀吳門之曳練，窮虞庭之蹈蹀，究遺野之環袨。

translations.literal: When Si Xia had ascended and Cai Qi was already presented, at first it paced circling with dragon bow, at last lush as it gazed like a phoenix; meeting Tiaolu upon the flying bell, hastening to Chengyun upon the startled arrow; portraying the dust filling the Qin wilds, depicting the white silk trailing at Wu Gate; exhausting the treading dance of the Yu court, reaching the ringed splendor of the distant field.
translations.idiomatic: When Si Xia had ascended and Cai Qi was already presented, at first it paced circling with dragon bow, at last lush as it gazed like a phoenix; meeting Tiaolu upon the flying bell, hastening to Chengyun upon the startled arrow; portraying the dust filling the Qin wilds, depicting the white silk trailing at Wu Gate; exhausting the treading dance of the Yu court, reaching the ringed splendor of the distant field.

sentences.zh: 若夫蹠實之態未卷，凌遠之氣方攄，歷岱野而過碣石，跨滄流而軼姑餘，朝送日於西坂，夕歸風於北都，尋瓊宮於倏瞬，望銀臺於須臾。

translations.literal: When the treading-solid form is not yet rolled up and the soaring-far spirit is just being released, it crosses the wilds of Dai and passes Jieshi, spans the blue stream and outruns Guyu; at dawn it sends off the sun at the western slope, at dusk it returns with the wind to the northern capital; seeking the jade palace in an instant, gazing at the silver terrace in a flash.
translations.idiomatic: When the treading-solid form is not yet rolled up and the soaring-far spirit is just being released, it crosses the wilds of Dai and passes Jieshi, spans the blue stream and outruns Guyu; at dawn it sends off the sun at the western slope, at dusk it returns with the wind to the northern capital; seeking the jade palace in an instant, gazing at the silver terrace in a flash.

sentences.zh: 若乃日宣重光，德星昭衍，國稱梁、岱佇蹕，史言壇場望踐。

translations.literal: If the sun proclaims double light and the virtue star spreads bright, the realm names Liang and Dai awaiting the imperial halt, and the histories speak of the altar ground awaiting the tread.
translations.idiomatic: If the sun proclaims double light and the virtue star spreads bright, the realm names Liang and Dai awaiting the imperial halt, and the histories speak of the altar ground awaiting the tread.

sentences.zh: 鄗上之瑞彰，江間之禎闡，榮鏡之運既臻，會昌之曆已辨，感五繇之程符，鑒群后之薦典。

translations.literal: Portents at Gao are revealed, omens between the rivers are displayed; the fortune of the glory mirror has arrived, the calendar of the great assembly is discerned; sensing the timed seals of the five charts, mirroring the sacrificial canons offered by all the lords.
translations.idiomatic: Portents at Gao are revealed, omens between the rivers are displayed; the fortune of the glory mirror has arrived, the calendar of the great assembly is discerned; sensing the timed seals of the five charts, mirroring the sacrificial canons offered by all the lords.

sentences.zh: 聖主將有事於東嶽，禮也。

translations.literal: The sage lord will perform rites at Mount Tai in the east—it is proper ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The sage lord will perform rites at Mount Tai in the east—it is proper ritual.

sentences.zh: 於是順斗極，乘次躔，戒懸日於昭旦，命月題於上年。

translations.literal: Thereupon following the Pole Star, riding the sequence of stations, setting the suspended sun for a bright dawn, naming the moon's inscription for the year above.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon following the Pole Star, riding the sequence of stations, setting the suspended sun for a bright dawn, naming the moon's inscription for the year above.

sentences.zh: 騑騑翼翼，泛修風而浮慶煙，肅肅雍雍，引八神而詔九仙。

translations.literal: Pair after pair wing upon wing, floating on cultivated winds and drifting auspicious smoke; solemn and harmonious, leading the eight spirits and proclaiming to the nine immortals.
translations.idiomatic: Pair after pair wing upon wing, floating on cultivated winds and drifting auspicious smoke; solemn and harmonious, leading the eight spirits and proclaiming to the nine immortals.

sentences.zh: 下齊郊而掩配林，集嬴裏而降祊田，蒲軒次巘，瑄璧承巒，金檢茲發，玉牒斯刊，盛節之義洽，升中之禮殫，億兆悅，精祗歡，聆萬歲於曾岫，燭神光於紫壇。

translations.literal: Descending to the Qi suburb and covering the paired grove, gathering at Yingli and descending to the border field; rush carriage halts at the peak, ceremonial jade and disk receive the mountain ridge; the gold tally is opened here, the jade document is engraved here; the meaning of the grand rite is complete, the ceremony of ascending and offering is fulfilled; the hundred millions rejoice, spirits and deities exult; listening for ten thousand years at the layered peak, lighting divine radiance upon the purple altar.
translations.idiomatic: Descending to the Qi suburb and covering the paired grove, gathering at Yingli and descending to the border field; rush carriage halts at the peak, ceremonial jade and disk receive the mountain ridge; the gold tally is opened here, the jade document is engraved here; the meaning of the grand rite is complete, the ceremony of ascending and offering is fulfilled; the hundred millions rejoice, spirits and deities exult; listening for ten thousand years at the layered peak, lighting divine radiance upon the purple altar.

sentences.zh: 是以擊轅之蹈，撫埃之舞，相與而歌曰：「聳朝蓋兮泛晨霞，靈之來兮雲漢華。

translations.literal: Thus the treading of cart-rims, the dance of brushing dust, together they sing: "Raising the morning canopy, floating through dawn clouds; the spirit comes, the Milky Way glorious.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the treading of cart-rims, the dance of brushing dust, together they sing: "Raising the morning canopy, floating through dawn clouds; the spirit comes, the Milky Way glorious.

sentences.zh: 山有壽兮松有茂，祚神極兮貺皇家。」

translations.literal: Mountains have longevity, pines have luxuriance; bless the divine pinnacle, bestow upon the imperial house."
translations.idiomatic: Mountains have longevity, pines have luxuriance; bless the divine pinnacle, bestow upon the imperial house."

sentences.zh: 然後悟聖朝之績，號慶榮之烈，比盛乎天地，爭明乎日月，茂實冠於胥、庭，鴻名邁於勛、發。

translations.literal: Then they comprehend the achievements of the sage court and proclaim the blaze of celebratory glory—comparing in grandeur with Heaven and Earth, vying in brilliance with sun and moon; luxuriant fruit crowns Xu and Ting, great name surpasses Xun and Fa.
translations.idiomatic: Then they comprehend the achievements of the sage court and proclaim the blaze of celebratory glory—comparing in grandeur with Heaven and Earth, vying in brilliance with sun and moon; luxuriant fruit crowns Xu and Ting, great name surpasses Xun and Fa.

sentences.zh: 業底於告成，道臻乎報謁，巍巍乎，蕩蕩乎，民無得而稱焉。

translations.literal: Works reach the report of completion, the Way attains the tribute visit—towering, vast—the people cannot find words to praise it.
